scope: Research triage and business/accounting red-team, not complete two-year underwriting or trade recommendations
ranking_note: Order reflects priority to resolve material uncertainty and suitability for deeper research, not expected returns or buy conviction.

companies.thesis: Accelerated computing platform, networking and software ecosystem capture AI infrastructure growth; reported Q2 FY27 demand is strong.
companies.bear_case: AI capital spending can reverse together across customers. Customer financing, cloud commitments, concentration, export controls and custom chips create correlated downside.
companies.valuation_method: Segment revenue × normalized margins, diluted share count and cash-flow scenarios; reverse DCF; compare NTM/current-FY/next-FY multiples explicitly.
companies.must_verify: Reconcile $36bn cloud service commitments and credit support to cash exposure; remove investment gains; consistent stock compensation treatment; vendor FCF discrepancy; calendarize EPS.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Documented cancellation or credit stress among large customers; sustained weakening of cash conversion with rising receivables; margins/demand below underwriting bear case.
companies.status: Research priority 1; unresolved cash-flow and commitment exposures; not approved

companies.thesis: Recurring enterprise software and cloud distribution offer multiple monetization routes; Azure and paid AI adoption underpin the case.
companies.bear_case: Compute investment and lease commitments may earn inadequate returns; demand, depreciation, competition and customer concentration can jointly compress cash generation.
companies.valuation_method: Segment DCF with explicit cash capex, finance and operating leases, depreciation and diluted shares; normalized operating earnings cross-check.
companies.must_verify: Capex presentation changed when future leases shifted finance to operating; reconcile economic investment, OpenAI investment gains and $0.27 Q4 discrete EPS benefit.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Cloud cash returns fail to improve as capacity enters service; material contracted-demand impairment; enduring operating-margin deterioration outside precommitted scenarios.
companies.status: Research priority 2; economic capex bridge required; not approved

companies.thesis: Specialized instruments, aerospace and automation exposure plus acquisition capabilities support durable industrial earnings.
companies.bear_case: Acquisition spending can hide weak organic returns; integration costs, leverage and multiple compression may outweigh earnings accretion.
companies.valuation_method: Organic-business DCF plus acquired-business incremental value, net of purchase price, financing and integration costs; normalized EV/EBITA and acquisition ROIC.
companies.must_verify: Pro forma debt/cash/interest after $5bn Indicor cash acquisition closed August 26; acquired EBITDA, synergies and goodwill; organic versus acquired growth.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Pro forma leverage or interest burden breaches approved limits; persistent organic order decline; acquired cash returns below funding cost.
companies.status: Research priority 3; balance sheet stale after acquisition; not approved

companies.thesis: All-flash storage and hybrid-cloud data management can benefit from enterprise modernization and AI workloads.
companies.bear_case: Hardware cycles, competition, mix and working-capital demands can interrupt growth; AI branding does not establish durable incremental profit.
companies.valuation_method: Hybrid/Public Cloud segment DCF; normalize working capital and restructuring, charge dilution once; NTM earnings and FCF cross-check.
companies.must_verify: Bridge revenue +30% to operating cash flow -25% and FCF -35%; assess receivables/inventory/payment timing and subsequent collections; gross-margin guidance.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Cash-conversion weakness persists beyond documented timing; weaker orders or renewals combined with inventory/receivable build; structural margin loss.
companies.status: Research priority 4; cash-conversion bridge required; not approved

companies.thesis: Commercial insurance underwriting, investment income and capital returns can support compounding when reserves and pricing remain disciplined.
companies.bear_case: Casualty reserve inflation, catastrophes, pricing competition and reserve-release reversal can overwhelm superficially cheap earnings.
companies.valuation_method: Normalized core EPS plus residual-income/price-to-book framework; sustainable ROE, catastrophe load, reserve stress and regulatory capital.
companies.must_verify: Exclude Hartford Funds discontinued operations and $251m tax benefit; examine Business Insurance underlying combined ratio 89.3 versus 88.0; reserve triangles and capital.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Adverse casualty reserve development, underwriting pricing below loss-cost inflation, or weakened statutory capital invalidates expected normalized profitability.
companies.status: Research priority 5; insurer-specific reserves/capital review required; not approved

companies.thesis: Corporate payments and expense controls offer organic growth alongside vehicle and lodging networks.
companies.bear_case: Acquisition integration, leverage, fuel/FX sensitivity, credit losses and regulatory liabilities may reduce distributable cash.
companies.valuation_method: Segment DCF and EV/EBITA with transaction-adjusted debt, customer funds excluded from surplus cash, dilution and recurring acquisition costs.
companies.must_verify: Rebuild CFO-minus-capex independently: company labels adjusted net income 'free cash flow'; $100m preliminary FTC settlement; 2.55x company leverage versus other definitions.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Core growth deteriorates while debt fails to fall; settlement economics materially exceed reserve; cash-flow bridge reveals recurring shortfall or customer-fund liquidity strain.
companies.status: Research priority 6; accounting/leverage reconciliation required; not approved

companies.thesis: Recurring payroll and HR services can retain customers and add products, with Paycor expanding scope.
companies.bear_case: Small-business employment weakness, integration execution, competition and lower interest earned on client funds constrain growth.
companies.valuation_method: Recurring-service DCF plus separate client-funds interest model; adjusted EPS cross-check after acquisition costs and debt service.
companies.must_verify: September 23 release reflected in estimates; organic versus acquired growth, Paycor retention/synergies, corporate cash versus client funds, debt maturities.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Client losses and weak sales offset synergies; lower cash earnings fail to cover dividend and deleveraging plan.
companies.status: Research priority 7; post-release estimates/integration review required; not approved

companies.thesis: Advice relationships and recurring asset-based fees can compound with client assets and advisor productivity.
companies.bear_case: Equity drawdowns reduce fee assets, net outflows harm scale, lower cash spreads hurt earnings, and insurance exposure adds capital risk.
companies.valuation_method: Sum of advice/wealth, asset management and insurance values; normalized earnings and excess-capital distribution, with segment capital constraints.
companies.must_verify: Organic net flows versus market appreciation; advisor retention/productivity; cash spreads; insurance capital; 55% adjusted ROE denominator distorted by buybacks/AOCI exclusion.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Persistent organic outflows plus advisor attrition or capital stress; EPS growth supported mainly by repurchases rather than operating earnings.
companies.status: Research priority 8; financial-services capital and flows review required; not approved

companies.thesis: Low-cost global brokerage and scalable technology can capture account and client-asset growth.
companies.bear_case: Rate cuts lower interest economics, trading activity normalizes, margin borrowers default, or operational failures damage trust.
companies.valuation_method: Normalized earnings/residual-income model separating commissions and interest across rate/activity scenarios; regulatory capital and ownership structure.
companies.must_verify: Split-adjusted shares/EPS; consolidated versus public-owner interests; customer funds versus corporate liquidity; monthly accounts/DARTs/net deposits and rate sensitivity.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Net account/deposit deterioration plus earnings sensitivity beyond stress budget; material operational or counterparty loss.
companies.status: Research priority 9; rates/capital/ownership reconciliation required; not approved

companies.thesis: Installed security hardware, specifications and electronic access adoption support replacement and construction demand.
companies.bear_case: Nonresidential construction weakness, acquisition execution, pricing pressure and international softness impair growth.
companies.valuation_method: Segment DCF, normalized EV/EBITA and explicit replacement/new-build split; organic growth separated from acquisition contribution.
companies.must_verify: Americas organic +8.9% versus International -1.2%; backlog conversion, channel inventories, price/cost, integration and current debt.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Organic bookings/contracts deteriorate with sustained price-cost margin pressure; electronic access fails to improve economic returns.
companies.status: Research priority 10; segment cycle and acquisition review required; not approved

companies.thesis: Professional repair-tool franchise and installed relationships support pricing and replacement demand.
companies.bear_case: Technician spending, franchisee health, tools cyclicality and credit losses can weaken together.
companies.valuation_method: Separate industrial operating value from finance-receivable book and credit earnings; normalized earnings/FCF and financing stress.
companies.must_verify: Finance receivables, delinquencies, write-offs and funding separated from industrial balance sheet; franchisee demand, organic volume versus price.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Repeated organic tool-volume declines combined with rising credit losses or franchisee stress.
companies.status: Research priority 11; captive-finance review required; not approved

companies.thesis: Device protection and specialty housing insurance can generate recurring partner-distributed earnings.
companies.bear_case: Catastrophe losses, reinsurance cost, partner concentration, repair costs and adverse reserve changes can reduce capital returns.
companies.valuation_method: Segment normalized earnings plus residual income; expected catastrophe losses retained as economic expense; statutory capital and reinsurance stress.
companies.must_verify: Reported/adjusted/ex-cat earnings reconciled; partner renewal concentration, catastrophe retention, reinsurance recoverability and subsidiary dividend capacity.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Loss of major distribution partner, worsening claims economics or statutory-capital pressure beyond modeled stress.
companies.status: Research priority 12; insurer capital/partner review required; not approved

companies.thesis: Brand pricing and direct-to-consumer execution can improve sales mix and margins across regions.
companies.bear_case: Price elevation can conceal unit weakness; fashion risk, tariffs, FX, wholesale exposure and inventory markdowns challenge durability.
companies.valuation_method: Regional DCF with units × realized price, channel mix and normalized markdowns; mid-cycle EBIT/FCF and diluted shares.
companies.must_verify: Unit growth versus 15% average unit retail increase; inventories, sell-through, markdowns, tariff offset and China exposure; founder/governance structure.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Inventory persistently outgrows sales while units and gross margin weaken; brand pricing power proves unsustainable.
companies.status: Research priority 13; demand/valuation confirmation required; not approved

companies.thesis: Global marketplace network, supply diversity and direct traffic can support travel volume and attractive unit economics.
companies.bear_case: Travel cyclicality, regulation, host/guest dissatisfaction, competition and new-service investment can weaken profitable growth.
companies.valuation_method: Nights × booking value × take rate operating model; normalized cash conversion excluding guest-funds timing; dilution and expansion spending.
companies.must_verify: Nights versus pricing growth, geographic regulation, service investment payback, SBC/diluted shares and seasonality of customer advance payments.
companies.invalidation_trigger: Persistent relative nights-growth slowdown, adverse regulatory supply loss or new-service costs that reduce core unit economics without retention gains.
companies.status: Research priority 14; unit-economics and cash-flow review required; not approved
